print('logging in spotify...')
spotify_password = [a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
access = apis.spotify.login(username='carbrown@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(access)

print('fetching song queue...')
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access['access_token'])
print(queue)
print('type:', type(queue))

print('Determining songs played so far (including current) from queue...')
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access['access_token'])
current_positions = [s['position'] for s in queue if s.get('is_current')]
current_pos = current_positions[0] if current_positions else None
print('current_pos:', current_pos)
played_so_far = [s for s in queue if s['position'] <= current_pos]
target_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in played_so_far]
print('target_song_ids:', target_song_ids)
print('count:', len(target_song_ids))
